Prompt Engineering Learning Plan (Generative AI + Agentic AI)
Beginner → Advanced Roadmap for AI Product Engineering (2026)
Goal
Learn Prompt Engineering specifically for:
Generative AI
AI SaaS Applications
AI Chatbots
RAG Systems
AI Agents
Agentic Workflows
This roadmap focuses ONLY on practical topics actually used in modern AI engineering.
PHASE 1 — LLM Fundamentals (VERY IMPORTANT)
Goal
Understand how LLMs work at a practical level.
Topics To Learn
Core Concepts
What is an LLM
How LLMs work (high-level)
Transformer architecture basics
Tokens
Tokenization
Context Window
Temperature
Hallucinations
Reasoning Models
What You Should Understand
Tokens
LLMs process text as tokens, not words.
Context Window
The memory size available during a request.
Temperature
Controls creativity/randomness.
Hallucinations
AI generating incorrect/confidently wrong information.
Best Resources
Official Docs
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/prompt-engineering
https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview
https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/prompts/introduction-prompt-design
Practice Platforms
https://platform.openai.com/playground
https://claude.ai
https://gemini.google.com
PHASE 2 — Core Prompt Structure (MOST IMPORTANT)
Goal
Learn how prompts are structured in real AI systems.
Topics To Learn
Prompt Components
Context
Role Prompting
Instructions
Constraints
Output Formatting
Examples
Tone & Personality
Prompt Structure Example
Context:
Building an AI SaaS app
Role:
Senior Backend Architect
Instruction:
Design scalable authentication architecture
Constraints:
Use Redis + Session Cookies
Output:
Step-by-step explanation with architecture
Best Resources
https://learnprompting.org
https://www.promptingguide.ai
https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/chatgpt-prompt-engineering-for-developers/
PHASE 3 — Prompting Techniques (EXTREMELY IMPORTANT)
Goal
Learn practical prompting techniques used in Generative AI.
Topics To Learn
Core Prompting Techniques
Zero-shot Prompting
Few-shot Prompting
Chain-of-Thought Prompting
Step-by-step Prompting
Role Prompting
Structured Prompting
XML Prompting (advanced)
Delimiter Prompting (advanced)
Multi-turn Prompting (advanced)
1. Zero-shot Prompting
Definition
Giving instructions without examples.
Example
Explain JWT authentication.
2. Few-shot Prompting
Definition
Providing examples before asking the task.
Example
Input: React
Output: Frontend library
Input: MongoDB
Output:
3. Chain-of-Thought Prompting (VERY IMPORTANT)
Definition
Asking AI to reason step-by-step.
Example
Think step-by-step before answering.
Used In
AI agents
reasoning systems
planning systems
4. Role Prompting
Definition
Giving AI an identity/expertise.
Example
Act as a senior MERN architect.
Best Resources
https://www.promptingguide.ai/techniques
https://www.kaggle.com/whitepaper-prompt-engineering
PHASE 4 — Structured Outputs (VERY IMPORTANT)
Goal
Learn how to generate reliable machine-readable outputs.
Topics To Learn
Structured Outputs
JSON Outputs
JSON Schema Prompting
Structured Response Generation
Output Validation
Example JSON Output
{
"title": "",
"summary": "",
"tags": []
}
Why This Is Important
Structured outputs are used in:
AI SaaS apps
automation systems
AI workflows
AI agents
APIs
Best Resources
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs
https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses
PHASE 5 — Developer/System Prompting (MOST IMPORTANT)
Goal
Learn how production AI systems control model behavior.
Topics To Learn
Prompt Roles
Developer/System Prompt
User Prompt
Assistant Role
Instructions vs Roles
Multi-turn Conversations
Context Preservation
Role Hierarchy
Developer/System
↓
User
↓
Assistant
Example
Developer Prompt:
You are a senior AI coding mentor.
User Prompt:
Explain React hooks.
Assistant:
Generated response
Best Resources
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/conversation-state
https://model-spec.openai.com
PHASE 6 — Context Engineering (VERY IMPORTANT IN 2026)
Goal
Learn how modern AI systems manage memory and context.
Topics To Learn
Context Engineering
Context Injection
Dynamic Prompting
Prompt Templates
Memory Systems
Context Trimming
Conversation Management
Retrieval Injection
Why This Is Important
Modern AI engineering is shifting from:
Prompt Engineering
to:
Context Engineering
Best Resources
https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/conversation-state
PHASE 7 — Prompting for RAG Systems
Goal
Learn prompting techniques used in Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
Topics To Learn
RAG Prompting
Retrieval Prompting
Citation Prompting
Grounding
Context-aware Prompting
Example
Answer ONLY using the provided documents.
If information is missing, say "I don't know."
Best Resources
https://python.langchain.com/docs/concepts/rag/
https://www.pinecone.io/learn/
PHASE 8 — Prompting for AI Agents (MOST IMPORTANT FOR AGENTIC AI)
Goal
Learn how prompts control autonomous AI systems.
Topics To Learn
Agent Prompting
ReAct Prompting
Planning Prompts
Reflection Prompts
Tool Calling Prompts
Retry Prompting
Multi-step Reasoning
Tool Calling Prompt Example
If external information is needed,
use the available tools before answering.
Best Resources
https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/
https://python.langchain.com/docs/modules/agents/
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/function-calling
PHASE 9 — Prompt Frameworks
Goal
Learn practical frameworks for writing better prompts.
Frameworks To Learn
CRISPE
RTF
RISEN
Chain-of-Thought
ReAct
PHASE 10 — Prompt Security
Goal
Learn how to secure AI systems.
Topics To Learn
AI Security
Prompt Injection
Jailbreak Prevention
Hallucination Reduction
Validation Prompting
Safe Prompting
Best Resources
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/safety-best-practices
MOST IMPORTANT TOPICS TO MASTER
Focus MOST on these topics:
HIGH PRIORITY
Developer/System Prompting
Chain-of-Thought Prompting
Structured Outputs
Context Engineering
RAG Prompting
Tool Calling Prompts
Conversation Architecture
Agent Prompting
